reason: The estimate uses a subsample trimmed on the outcome (top and bottom 1% of productivity_2023, N=1960 rather than 2000), which can bias the effect and is not justified. The model also omits the available 2020 pre-period confounders (R&D, export share, credit score and others), and the p=0.023 result is marginal, so a 'positive effect' conclusion is not robust. The controls used are pre-treatment and include lagged productivity, so those two checks pass. I could not re-run the analysis because shell execution was denied.
